_comment: Verbatim (lightly trimmed) from Shane's verified 5-star Google reviews, first name + last initial. Source screenshots: _context/harvest/2026-05-28-owner-photo-drop/Reviews screenshot/. Do not edit wording; add or remove entries only.

reviews.name: Steven B.
reviews.body: Shane did a great job with the plumbing for my bathroom remodel. On time, good communication, and minded every detail. Will definitely keep his name and number for the future.

reviews.name: Daniel M.
reviews.body: Shane responded quickly to an urgent furnace repair in the middle of a winter deep freeze. Other plumbers said it could not be fixed — Shane said “I can fix it,” and he did.

reviews.name: Clare G.
reviews.body: We had a last-minute plumbing issue in our bathroom and Shane came out the same day without hesitation. Incredibly fair, honest, and responsive from start to finish. 10/10 service.

reviews.name: Carly C.
reviews.body: Shane came out quickly and replaced the water heater without any delays. He was so understanding of my situation with four kids at home and got our hot water back as soon as possible.

reviews.name: Luke B.
reviews.body: Same-day visit, and he arrived exactly when he said he would. Quickly diagnosed and resolved the problem, explained it in plain terms, and his pricing was very reasonable.

reviews.name: Iva V.
reviews.body: Great job on a holiday morning for a plumbing emergency. Fast, quality work that started even before the visit via video, so we didn’t waste time. Very accommodating.

reviews.name: Val K.
reviews.body: Very professional and pays close attention to detail. He added safety, functionality, and modernity to our plumbing at a very fair price, and explained red flags to watch for.

reviews.name: Laura C.
reviews.body: After more than a week and multiple professionals trying to fix a complex problem in our building, Shane did it. Professional, knowledgeable, and willing to take the time to get it right.

reviews.name: Amy C.
reviews.body: Excellent at his craft, smart, and a true problem solver. Honest, dependable, and operates with real integrity. I’ve used his services multiple times and referred him to others.

reviews.name: Emilio D.
reviews.body: As a facilities manager responsible for multiple properties, I can say S. Meredith Plumbing is one of the best. Always prompt and dependable, and their pricing is very fair.
